create.name: Pamela Miles
create.bio:
Pamela Miles is the woman who carried reiki through the doors of Harvard, Yale, and the National Institutes of Health. An international Reiki master practising since 1986 in the direct lineage of Hawayo Takata — the teacher who first brought reiki to the West — she became the foremost pioneer of Medical Reiki: creating reiki programs in New York’s most prominent hospitals, publishing in peer-reviewed medical journals, collaborating in NIH-funded research, and proving, patiently and rigorously, that this gentle Japanese practice could stand respectfully alongside conventional medicine. Her award-winning book, REIKI: A Comprehensive Guide, remains the standard text handed to skeptics, physicians, and serious students alike.

Her teaching is as traditional as her credibility is modern. From her New York City practice and her live, small-group online trainings, Pamela teaches First Degree Reiki as Takata taught it — anchored in daily self-practice, spiritual grounding, and a credible, science-respecting sensibility that never oversells and never waters down. She is famously exacting (“many who consider themselves Reiki masters have less training than my beginning students”) and that exactness is precisely her gift: in a field that can drift into vagueness, Pamela Miles is reiki’s clearest, most trustworthy voice — the teacher for anyone who wants their healing practice to hold up in both the sanctuary and the clinic.

books.title: Reiki: A Comprehensive Guide
books.author: Pamela Miles
books.description: The award-winning standard text on reiki. Pamela Miles covers its history, how it is practised and the research behind it, bringing more than two decades of clinical and teaching experience to the book. It is grounded, respects science and is written to stay beside you as a practice companion, which is why it suits newcomers, serious students and sceptical physicians alike.

courses.title: Traditional First Degree Reiki – Learn Reiki Online
courses.description: First Degree reiki as Hawayo Takata taught it, delivered live by Pamela in three small-group sessions online or in Manhattan, with new cohorts through the year. It covers reiki history, the precepts, self-treatment, using reiki alongside medical care, and an initiation, with two optional one-to-one mentoring sessions within six months.

courses.title: Reiki & Medicine Masterclass
courses.description: A live online series of ten 2.5-hour sessions on bringing reiki into conventional healthcare. It covers the research evidence, how to talk with doctors and patients, and professionalism and safety, with Pamela's four-phase template for proposing a hospital programme. Join the waitlist for the next series.

courses.title: Reiki Professional Academy
courses.description: Nine self-paced trainings for reiki professionals. They cover how to structure sessions, set fees, hold boundaries, teach First Degree and introduce Medical Reiki, to help practitioners grow a respected practice with integrity.

courses.title: Introduction to Medical Reiki Video Training
courses.description: A two-hour on-demand video training on proposing a reiki programme to hospitals and medical settings. It covers what doctors do and don't want to hear, safety, appropriate language and how to start without a healthcare licence, with a four-phase proposal template.

courses.title: Better Boundaries
courses.description: A two-week self-paced programme of daily 15–20 minute practices and writing prompts, with a private community and two live Q&As with Pamela. It helps you set boundaries that are kind to yourself and to others. Join the waitlist for the next cohort.

courses.title: Write Reiki
courses.description: A two-week practice and mentoring programme that pairs daily self-reiki with up to 15 minutes of writing from a prompt, with a private online community and optional live calls with Pamela. Open to anyone with First Degree training; join the waitlist for the next dates.

free_resources.title: Reiki Timer with Pamela Miles (app)
free_resources.description: A free, customisable timer for reiki practice, alone, with a partner or teaching a class. It sounds soft chimes between hand placements and offers silence or bansuri flute music by Steve Gorn, which makes it ideal for building a daily self-practice. Also on Google Play.
